task: Remove the five-submissions-per-IP hourly audit cap.
nonGoals: Keep the shared 60-submissions-per-hour cap, cache accounting, usage safeguards, parser, frontend, production, and D1 schema unchanged.

outcomes.description: A single client can submit more than five audits per hour while app-wide admission still caps at 60.
outcomes.evidence: Queue submission and transactional D1 admission tests, including cache hits and hour rollover.

process.description: Obtain independent review and run hosted CI before release.
process.evidence: Separate plan, tests, review and pull request.

styleEfficiency.description: Remove only the per-IP rejection path and preserve current audit storage and accounting.

exitTest.reason: Only the admission predicate changes. Queue ownership, checkpoints and resume are unaffected.
